networkPolicy.desc: The app's own media server is blocked: surf trip promotions, marketplace photos, news pictures and camera stills; forecasts and live cameras stay open

notes:
Written from the binary (a Flutter app, 5.1.2) and watched on a device through the tunnel. It carries its own promotions next to AdMob: surf trip packages and a marketplace of used gear, both with photos, some of them of people. All of those pictures come from media.gosurf.co.il (surf-trips/..., marketplace uploads, news thumbnails), so that host is blocked. The cards stay, with their text and no picture.

What keeps working: gosurf.co.il (the API, app config and forecasts) and live.gosurf.co.il (the camera streams). The camera stills on the home screen also come from media.gosurf.co.il and go dark; opening a camera plays the live stream.

AdMob (ca-app-pub-4008759075486927) is stopped by the global blocklist; with it, the banners showed Temu with images from aimg.kwcdn.com and img.kwcdn.com, which load only after the ad request succeeds.
